newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain Insurance ups net, plans bonus issue.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain Insurance ups net, plans bonus issue.

text.p: Bahrain Insurance Co (BIC) on Tuesday announced a 29 percent increase in 1996 net profits and said it planned a one-for-four bonus share issue.
BIC made a 876,000 dinar net profit in 1996, up 29 percent on the previous year. Earnings per share increased by 29.3 percent to 37.8 fils. The company gave no comparative figure.

It said the board of directors recommended the bonus issue to shareholders on record April 7, 1997. The new shares, which will be eligible for dividends from this year, will increase its paid-in capital to three million dinars ($8.0 million).

"Despite recessionary market conditions for the second year in a row and falling premium rates, the company has been able to increase its gross premiums by over 11 percent to 5.34 million dinars," chairman Qassim Mohammed Fakhro said.
He said net earned premiums including the life business were 16 percent higher at 2.78 million dinars. Underwriting profits increased four-fold to 276,000 dinars.
